description: This file contains the implementation of low-level system interface functions for the FreeType project, including memory management, stream handling, and resource management specific to ANSI systems.

methods.name: ft_alloc
methods.description: Memory allocation function that wraps ft_smalloc.

methods.name: ft_realloc
methods.description: Memory reallocation function that wraps ft_srealloc.

methods.name: ft_free
methods.description: Memory free function that wraps ft_sfree.

methods.name: FT_Stream_Open
methods.description: Function to open a file stream for reading font data.

methods.name: FT_New_Memory
methods.description: Creates a new FT_Memory object with default function pointers.

methods.name: FT_Done_Memory
methods.description: Frees an FT_Memory object and associated resources.
